LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Hostile.label: hostile
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Hostile.description: Sees sex slavery as an evil that must be uprooted — no one should be bound in chains and made to serve another with their body. This culture regards such domination as the most abhorrent of crimes, to be wiped out at any cost.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Revulsion.label: revulsion
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Revulsion.descripti: Deeply repulsed by sex slavery; the sight of a person bowing beneath a chain turns the stomach, and one would rather not share a room with anyone who serves as a slave.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Indifference.label: indifference
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Indifference.descri: Does not care whether sex slavery stands or falls, and has no wish to cheer it on. In these people's eyes, chains and collars are merely other people's private business.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Respect.label: respect
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Respect.description: Acknowledges that a sex slave is still a person, and that even with a collar around the neck they are owed basic respect and personal dignity.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Sacred.label: sacred
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Sacred.description: Regards the sex slave as one chosen by the god — naked, crawling on all fours, offering every inch of flesh and every climax to a master, refining holiness out of the whip, the penetration and the swallowing. This utter taming is itself the highest praise of the god.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Envy.label: envy
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SexSlave_Envy.description: Envies the ones who wear a collar at their throat: they have found their place, their flesh is no longer lonely, night after night they are pinned beneath a master and filled to the deepest part, climbing to climax in coupling and domination. The faithful who hold no chain itch in secret, their loins growing wet, longing for the day they too can kneel beneath a master's hips, be possessed, be trained, be fucked until they gladly sink.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Trainer_Hostile.label: hostile
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Trainer_Hostile.description: Regards the training officer as a desecration of the master-slave order — how can a third party be allowed to thrust a hand between master and slave? The duty of training belongs to the master alone; to hand it to another is usurpation.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Trainer_Revulsion.label: revulsion
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Trainer_Revulsion.descriptio: Strongly repulsed by the very existence of training officers; to see one taming people with whip and chain is to see something base and squalid.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Trainer_Indifference.label: indifference
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Trainer_Indifference.descrip: Does not care whether training officers persist or what they do; the business of training is no concern of theirs.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Trainer_Reverence.label: reverence
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Trainer_Reverence.descriptio: Acknowledges the training officer's craft, and offers sincere respect for the skill that can whip a wild creature into submission and train it into a proper sex slave who bows their head and takes their master gladly.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Trainer_SacredOffice.label: sacred office
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Trainer_SacredOffice.descrip: Regards the office of training officer as sacred — they take the whip as their ritual tool and the chain as their holy vessel, training on the master's behalf slaves whose presented asses are red and swollen, whose cunts are soaked, who are obedient and devout; their office is as solemn as that of a priest.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Master_Hostile.label: hostile
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Master_Hostile.description: Regards the master as a usurper who seizes another's body — to take a person's flesh and will by mere chain is an intolerable atrocity.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Master_Revulsion.label: revulsion
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Master_Revulsion.description: Strongly repulsed by the role of "master"; the sight of someone walking with a chain in hand stirs disgust.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Master_Indifference.label: indifference
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Master_Indifference.descript: Neither approves nor objects to the role of master; who is master and who is slave is no affair of theirs.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Master_Deference.label: deference
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Master_Deference.description: Reveres the master's will and gladly obeys — the master is master of desire and master of order; to kneel beneath a master's hips and obey every command is to obey the decree of heaven.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Master_HolyMaster.label: holy master
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_Master_HolyMaster.descriptio: Regards the master as a deity to be venerated, and gives them the highest reverence. Every thrust and every command of the master is divine will; the faithful should devote themselves with tongue, breasts and cunt, offering up their climax as sacrifice — to be the one who brings the master to release is the highest glory a believer can know.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_MasterCount_One.label: one only
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_MasterCount_One.description: The colony accepts at most one master. Many masters side by side bring disorder; only with one master can desire keep its proper place.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_MasterCount_Three.label: three or fewer
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_MasterCount_Three.descriptio: The colony accepts at most three masters. Masters may be many, but not without limit; order must live within restraint.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_MasterCount_Unlimited.label: unlimited
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_MasterCount_Unlimited.descri: The more masters the better; the more masters, the more desires are satisfied, the more slaves have somewhere to belong.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SlaveCount_One.label: one only
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SlaveCount_One.description: Each master keeps at most one sex slave. Only by holding her cunt exclusively is their favor shown to be undivided, and only then do the links of the chain fit tight and true.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SlaveCount_Three.label: three or fewer
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SlaveCount_Three.description: Each master keeps at most three sex slaves. The joys of several may be enjoyed and three cunts may be pierced, but the care given to training must not be lost.
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SlaveCount_Unlimited.label: unlimited
LanguageData.SSC_Precept_SlaveCount_Unlimited.descrip: The more sex slaves the better; the more slaves, the more cunts to ride, the greater the master's glory, the fuller the satisfaction of desire.
